chapter_title: The Chapter of the Man who asks: Why [am] I someti
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶6.** The interior spiritual life, when it is conjoined to the external natural mind, receives influx of Divine Truth from the Lord; whereupon it is reformed through the power of wisdom received and obedience rendered, and it is purified and made into a regenerate person. In this state there is no spiritual conflict within the interior life, no confusion of understanding, and no disturbance of the will.

---

**¶7.** Yet when temptation arises and the person is thrown into spiritual combat, this disturbance enters into the interior life in [GAP-1] successive degrees — first through hereditary evil inclinations and adverse tendencies from birth, which [GAP-2] revolve upon the person and agitate and disturb through concupiscence and hostility toward truth and spiritual desolation and anguish, according to what the person's own will permits. Moreover, according to what the will permits, the societies of the spiritual world exert their influence through the interior connections to which the person is bound.

---

**¶8.** Again, there are times when the influx from the spiritual societies is at rest and in order for the person, and it comes to pass that [GAP-3] a harmful element enters the interior life through the goods and truths that have been appropriated from external life, or indeed through some [GAP-4] particular form of external experience, or through the truths that have been received into the understanding. Then conflict and confusion and hostility to good increase within, and concupiscence multiplies together with desolation and anguish — because the goods of the will that were appropriated and the truths of the understanding that were received are full of admixtures of evil and falsity, constituting a vindictive purpose from the proprium. These enter the external natural mind, [GAP-5: REVIEW mixed in] together with what is appropriated, and they become conjoined with the evil tendencies already present in the natural mind and with the hereditary evil that dwells therein — exciting hostility toward good, concupiscence, spiritual desolation, and anguish, which are the evil cogitations proceeding from the unregenerate selfhood.

---

**¶9.** Should you be cast into spiritual combat, [GAP-6] these evils act through the channels of influx and the interior connections of the spiritual societies above, [GAP-7] so that the overwhelming influx of falsity that enters into you may be recognized as such.

---

**¶10.** There are times, however, when the goods and truths appropriated into your life are genuine [GAP-8] and unmixed, so that there is more wisdom and spiritual life within them while the falsity and evil in them is less, and the destructive tendency is diminished. Even the spiritual sphere surrounding you is at rest, being purified through the [GAP-9] activity of the Divine order upon it. Also the external form of the mind is calmed from [GAP-10] its former agitation, and what increases in you does so through those genuine goods that are appropriated into the interior life. And they find you in a state of peace and spiritual rest, well-governed in your interior states, because the living spiritual element within predominates — on account of the light of wisdom from those perfected goods and truths that reside within. These are the goods and truths that have completed their spiritual uses. Their obligations of restitution have ended, and the interior spiritual life is free from anxiety [GAP-11] because they have been conjoined with those living goods and truths that are present within you. On account of this you find them within you, dwelling in tranquility, and they proceed from you without conflict; and you are found flourishing in your external life. Your works also are rightly ordered, being well formed according to their proper nature, and your doctrines of understanding are arranged in due sequence, as your expressions of truth [GAP-12] correspond to their interior source, and your interior spiritual life rises freely within you, ascending like rational thought toward the Lord.

---

**¶11.** When your external natural mind is in conflict, you are disturbed through the channels of influx from the lower natural degree — the harmful elements that enter through the appropriation of external goods and truths. Conversely, when the channels of influx from the spiritual are at peace toward you, and the goods and truths you have appropriated are clear and genuine, then your will is found rightly ordered in its place, and the deliberations of your understanding are free from the disturbance of falsity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The soul that assumes the body, when the Light Mind will come to it, shall be purified by the power of wisdom and obedience, and it is cleansed and made a new man. There is no trouble in (the soul), nor confusion nor disturbance.

However, when a disturbance will arise for him and he will be troubled, this disturbance shall go into him in [many ways], first through his birth-signs and his difficult stars that [are upon him, and] they turn over him and stir him and trouble him with lust and anger and depression and grief, as he wills. Also, as he wills, the powers of heaven shall trouble him through their roots, to which he is attached.

Again, there are times you shall find the powers of heaven are peaceful and tranquil for him, and it comes to [pass that] a difficult part comes into him by the nourishment that he has eaten, or else indeed in some [drink] or in the water that they have drunk. Again, trouble and confusion and anger will increase in him, and lust multiplies upon him together with depression and grief; because of the nourishment of the bread he has eaten and the water he has drunk, which are full of bothersome parts, a vengeful counsel. They shall enter his body, [mixed in] with these foods, and they even become joined in with the wicked parts of the body and the Sin that is in him; transferring the anger and the lust and the depression and the grief, these wicked thoughts of the body.
should you be troubled [know that it comes to you from] them through the conduits and the roots of they above [so that you may recognise] the flood that comes into you.

There are times, however, if you shall find that the nourishment that comes into you is pure [and clear, and full of good parts], so it is greater in light and life while the waste is less in it, and the evil-doing is diminished from it. Even the atmosphere above is still, being purified through the [ ... ... ] also the image is calmed from [its disturbance, and what] increases in you through those good parts of the food that come into you. And they find you at ease and tranquil, as you are well governed in your abodes because of the living part, which is greater on account of the light of these justified souls that are in it. The ones that have perfected their deeds. Their dues have ceased, while their soul is carefree [because] they have been allied with these living souls that [are p]resent in you. Due to this you shall find them in you, calm in tranquillity, and they come from you without trouble; and you are found flourishing of body. Even your deeds are determined, being well constructed after their manner, and your doctrines are in order, as your words [are true, and] your soul is carefree within you, ascending like a bird.

when [your bo]dy is troubled, you shall be troubled by the conduits of they below, the difficult parts that come into you by food and the act of eating. Again, when the conduits above are calmed from you, even your food that has come into you is clear and pure. Your heart shall be found ordered in its place, your counsels at peace from disturbance.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "successive degrees," and the text immediately enumerates multiple channels of disturbance ("first through his birth-signs... Also... the powers of heaven"), so "many ways" introduces this enumeration in natural Kephalaia register.

The difficult stars are positioned over the person in Manichaean astrological cosmology; this positional phrase establishes their authority before the active verbs "turn over him and stir him," matching the spiritual reading's "adverse tendencies which revolve upon the person."
Standard Kephalaia idiom "it comes to pass that" introduces a new event — the spiritual reading confirms "it comes to pass that a harmful element enters."

The text lists sources of harmful intake: nourishment eaten, then "some [drink]," then water drunk — creating a triad of consumables; "drink" is distinct from plain water and corresponds to the spiritual reading's "particular form of external experience" that differs from both general goods (food) and natural truths (water).

The editor's "mixed in" accurately renders the spiritual sense of evil and falsity being admixed with appropriated goods ("mixed in together with what is appropriated"), and fits the Kephalaia's language of dark parts mingling with food entering the body.

fills.fill: know that it comes to you from
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "these evils act upon you through the channels of influx"; the gap must bridge from "be troubled" to "them through the conduits," requiring an epistemic verb ("know") and a mechanism phrase ("comes to you from"), with "them" referring to the spiritual powers acting through the conduits.

The spiritual reading specifies "so that the overwhelming influx of falsity that enters into you may be recognized as such"; a purposive recognition clause naturally bridges from "they above" to "the flood that comes into you," completing ¶9's instruction to discern the sources of disturbance.

fills.fill: and clear, and full of good parts
fills.explanation: Mirrors the chapter's earlier negative description of impure food as "full of bothersome parts" by inverting it; "clear" pairs with "pure" as a standard Kephalaia doublet (cf. ¶11: "clear and pure"), and "full of good parts" corresponds to the spiritual reading's "unmixed" — i.e., dominated by genuine goods.

The spiritual reading maps this to "its former agitation, and what increases in you"; "disturbance" is the chapter's key term for spiritual conflict (¶6–7), and "what" serves as the subject of "increases in you through those good parts."

The spiritual reading specifies a causal connection: "free from anxiety because they have been conjoined" — the soul is carefree because of its alliance with the living souls, requiring the causal conjunction "because."

The spiritual reading says "expressions of truth correspond to their interior source" — in the Kephalaia's natural register, words that correspond to their interior source are words that "are true," paralleling the preceding phrase about doctrines being "in order."
